title: 중3 레벨테스트 A형
description: 초급~중급: 생활·감정 어휘와 숙어, 수동태·관계대명사 which·so ~ that·현재분사·if(~인지)·too ~ to, 소셜 미디어 설명문·발표 걱정 대화 읽기

passages.title: Social Media and Teens
passages.text:
Many teenagers spend hours on social media every day.
It is a good way to keep in touch with friends and share interesting news.
However, using it too much can cause problems.
Some students stay up late watching videos, so they feel tired in class.
Others feel sad when they compare their lives with the perfect photos of others.
Experts suggest that we set a time limit for using social media.

passages.title: A Big Presentation
passages.text:
A: You look worried. What's wrong?
B: I have to give a presentation in English tomorrow, but I'm so nervous.
A: Why don't you practice in front of your family tonight?
B: That's a good idea. I'll try it.
A: Don't worry. I'm sure you'll do well.

items.explanation: compare = 비교하다 (준비하다 prepare, 완성하다 complete, 공유하다 share)
keep in touch with ~ = ~와 연락하고 지내다

items.stimulus: I was so ____ before the speech that my hands were shaking.
items.explanation: 손이 떨릴 정도로 → 긴장한(nervous) (calm 차분한)

items.stimulus: a person who knows a lot about a subject
items.explanation: 어떤 분야를 아주 잘 아는 사람 = expert(전문가) (beginner 초보자, customer 손님)
stay up late = 늦게까지 (자지 않고) 깨어 있다

items.prompt: 문맥상 단어의 쓰임이 어색한 문장을 고르세요.
choices: The medicine had a bad side effect.
He suggested going to the beach.
She lost weight because she ate too much.
items.explanation: 너무 많이 먹어서 살이 빠졌다(lost weight)는 어색하다. → gained weight(살이 쪘다)

items.stimulus: Too much screen time can ____ eye problems.
items.explanation: 화면을 너무 오래 보면 눈 문제를 일으킬(cause) 수 있다. (solve 해결하다, prevent 막다, cure 치료하다)

items.prompt: 두 단어의 관계가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르세요.
items.explanation: succeed(성공하다) → success(성공, 명사)처럼 decide(결정하다) → decision(결정, 명사)
영어는 '말해진다' → 수동태 is + 과거분사 spoken

items.stimulus: This is the house ____ my grandfather built.
items.explanation: 선행사 the house(사물) + 목적격 관계대명사 → which (that도 가능)

items.stimulus: The movie was ____ that I watched it twice.
items.explanation: so + 형용사 + that ~ = 너무 ~해서 …하다 → so interesting that
'자고 있는' 아기 → 능동·진행의 현재분사 sleeping이 명사를 꾸민다.

items.stimulus: I don't know ____ he will come or not.
items.explanation: '~인지 아닌지' → if(= whether) ~ or not

choices: The letter was written by her.
I have been to China twice.
He is the boy who I met yesterday.
items.explanation: 사람이 관심을 느끼는 것은 과거분사 → She is interested in music.

items.stimulus: He is too young ____ a car.
items.explanation: too + 형용사 + to부정사 = 너무 ~해서 …할 수 없다 → too young to drive

choices: 소셜 미디어의 장점과 지나친 사용의 문제
items.explanation: 장점(연락·소식 공유) → However(그러나) 지나친 사용의 문제 → 사용 시간 제한 제안

items.prompt: 소셜 미디어의 좋은 점으로 글에 나온 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 친구와 연락하고 소식을 나눌 수 있다.
items.explanation: 'It is a good way to keep in touch with friends and share interesting news.'

items.prompt: 어떤 학생들이 슬픔을 느끼는 까닭은 무엇인가요?
choices: 다른 사람의 완벽한 사진과 자기 삶을 비교해서
items.explanation: 'Others feel sad when they compare their lives with the perfect photos of others.'

choices: 소셜 미디어 사용 시간을 정해 두기
items.explanation: 'Experts suggest that we set a time limit for using social media.' (time limit = 시간 제한)
'I have to give a presentation in English tomorrow, but I'm so nervous.'

items.prompt: A가 B에게 한 조언으로 알맞은 것은 무엇인가요?
choices: 오늘 밤 가족 앞에서 연습해 봐라.
items.explanation: 'Why don't you practice in front of your family tonight?' (Why don't you ~? = ~하는 게 어때?)

items.prompt: 우리말 뜻에 맞는 영어 단어를 쓰세요.
items.explanation: 전문가 = expert

items.prompt: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸에 쓰세요.
items.stimulus: This song is ______ by many people. (love)
accept: This song is loved by many people
items.explanation: 노래가 '사랑받는다' → 수동태 is + 과거분사 loved

items.prompt: 주어진 말을 바르게 배열하여 문장을 쓰세요.  (이것은 내가 어제 읽은 책이다.)
items.stimulus: ( I / the book / read yesterday / this is / which )
items.answer: This is the book which I read yesterday.
items.explanation: 선행사 the book + 목적격 관계대명사 which + 주어 I + 동사 read

items.prompt: 우리말에 맞게 영어 문장을 쓰세요.  <조건> so ~ that을 사용할 것
items.stimulus: 나는 너무 피곤해서 일찍 잠자리에 들었다.
items.answer: I was so tired that I went to bed early.
accept: I was so tired that I slept early
I was so tired that I went to sleep early
I was so tired that I went to bed early
I was so tired that I fell asleep early
items.explanation: so + 형용사 + that + 주어 + 동사 → I was so tired that I went to bed early.
